name: nix-bundle-app
description: Turn any Nix derivation into native installers (.deb, .rpm, AppImage, archlinux, .dmg, .pkg, NSIS .exe, .msi, flatpak, snap, brew, tar/zip) plus cargo-dist-style release matrices with install.sh/install.ps1. Ships a skill that lets Claude package, sign, and release from this repo's overlay without scanning the whole tree.
